scenario: LCRS.6.2.3 positive case — `as` as the trailing clause after kwargs admits cleanly. Pin: `call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" cooldown: 30_s as "k"` compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" cooldown: 30_s as "k"
